note: Prompts and ground paths for Kimodo (kimodo_batch.py). legs: see paths.py. Never put Epic GASP data in here (README.md).
description: One style prompt carried across a whole pack: idle, walk and run locomotion and parkour, all as a woman limping on her injured left leg, at slower paces (walk 1.2, run 3.0 m/s).
